releaseEvidence: The release's own files (windows-release.json, windows-signature.json, update-package.json, RELEASE-MANIFEST.json, Sigstore-signed SHA256SUMS), its ten windows-release.mjs stages on chromium/next (signing run 46160207457, staging gate 46161452889, verify-public 46162064035), the passing night 20261128-0400 it was released from (beta install 46129485029, installer capture 46129487010, suite 46129489292, 635 cases, none rerun), and chromium/STATUS.md's Windows section on chromium/next.

decisions: A Windows beta is its own GitHub pre-release, never latest, tagged chromium-beta-windows-<version>, version 158.0.8127.<build> (owner, 2026-11-19).

On /download it gets its own tile right after the Mac beta's, in the same dark style, never a platform choice (owner, 2026-11-21, from two layouts). The button goes to /dl/beta-win on the blanc-ping Worker, counted like the other /dl/* routes.
The tile's limits match the release notes the owner approved on 2026-11-21: no protected video, and some Blanc features behave differently on Windows.

158.0.8127.903 (owner, 2026-11-21: "release the next Windows beta"): the tile, its text and both limits stay as for 158.0.8127.902; only the release it names changes, matching the release notes the owner approved for it.

158.0.8127.904 (owner, 2026-11-21: "release the next Windows beta", release notes approved as written): the tile, its text and both limits stay as for 158.0.8127.903; only the release it names changes.

Compact release list (owner, 2026-11-23): the three betas share one dark panel across the row, headed Preview, Betas and one sentence, recorded in the Mac beta's ledger, so this row no longer repeats them; each beta is one row with its platform, its build number and Chromium major version and its download, and a Details control (closed by default) opens the full versions, the requirement and release day, what isn't in the beta yet and the release notes. The build number and Chromium lines appear twice, in the row and in the opened details, so they are recorded twice.

158.0.8127.907 (owner, 2026-11-22: "Update the Windows site download after it publishes"; release notes approved as written on 2026-11-23): the tile, its text and both limits stay as for 158.0.8127.904; only the release it names changes.

159.0.8154.913 (owner, 2026-11-25: "go" on shipping the first Chromium 159 betas; release notes approved as written): the tile, its text and both limits stay as for 158.0.8127.907; the release it names and its Chromium version (159.0.8154.33) change.

159.0.8154.913 (owner, 2026-11-28: "Yes, both" on releasing the night's Windows build; release notes approved as written): the tile, its text and both limits stay as for 159.0.8154.910; only the release it names changes.
